bullets.text: Young Minds App Launches - **Young Minds** aims to educate and protect children online, showcasing its tech at **TechCrunch Disrupt 2025**.
Heidi Health Secures Funding - **Heidi Health** raises $65M to enhance AI-driven administrative support for healthcare providers.
Apple's Backdoor Controversy - The British government persists in demanding **Apple** create a backdoor into **iCloud**, raising privacy concerns.
California's AI Safety Law - New legislation in California promotes AI safety without stifling innovation, setting a regulatory precedent.
Apple Glasses Rumors Surface - Anticipation builds for **Apple Glasses**, expected to feature AI capabilities and multiple cameras.
iPhone 17 Upgrades - The new **iPhone 17** features enhanced storage and display improvements, making it a compelling upgrade.
